SnapshotMeta.title: SnapshotMeta
SnapshotMeta.description:
How to read `/api/snapshot/values` for the same build: the build's metric values as
columns, for live screening in the browser (the server stays authoritative).

The values body is `len(metrics)` blocks of `n` little-endian float64 (NaN = null; booleans
as 1/0), then `len(metrics)` blocks of `n` uint8 reason codes: 0 = none, k = `note_codes[k-1]`
(info codes such as DERIVED_INPUT can sit beside a value). Note messages stay server-side.

SnapshotRows.title: SnapshotRows
SnapshotRows.description: One entry per company, in the same order as every values/notes block.

SnapshotScreenConfig.title: SnapshotScreenConfig
SnapshotScreenConfig.description:

then.title: Then
then.description: Tie-breakers after `by`, in order; ticker ascending always breaks what's left. Nulls sort last for every key.

stale_annual_report_months.description: A company is stale (left out by default) when its latest annual report is older than this many months (`freshness.stale_annual_report_months`)
